text:
Anika: quick post-dry-run update from this morning's private/VPC cutover dry run — customer reported three blockers, wiring them here so we can triage.
Luis: saw the logs, looks like audit log delivery throwing 403s to the S3 bucket endpoint. suspect IAM role/STS policy on the bastion lambda.
Marco: confirming NAT gw route table didn't have the 0.0.0.0/0 assoc for the worker subnets — egress to our telemetry S3 endpoint was failing. I pushed a temporary route in the test account.
Priya: KMS note from the customer: their security team requires key policy to include their org's admin role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/PrivOpsAdmins — we don't currently have that in the example policy.
Anika: customer also flagged retention / audit log visibility — they couldn't find deliveries in Splunk for the last 30m during the dry run. that raised a concern about go-live confidence and they asked about renewal cadence if this isn't ironed out.
telemetry-bot: alert: s3-put-errors increased to 17 in the last 10m for account acct-prod-827. Sample error: "AccessDenied: Access Denied".
Luis: action: I'll update the role trust policy and ensure the signed URL generator is using sts:AssumeRole to the customer's priv role. Will post diff.
Marco: infra action: revert the temporary route once we validate real fix. Adding a route table entry template to the runbook:
```
- route_table: rt-0a1b2c3d
  routes:
    - cidr: 0.0.0.0/0
      target: nat-0f1e2d3c
```
Luis: also we need to add S3 VPC endpoint configuration to the runbook (policy allowing PutObject for redwood-logs prefix).
Priya: I'll prepare a one-pager for the customer's security reviewers with exact KMS key policy diff + minimal privileges. Customer feedback: they want "single canonical runbook" not 6 fragments.
Anika: ok assignments: @Luis update IAM/KMS policy snippets by EOD PST; @Marco add route + endpoint templates and test in staging by 12:00PT tomorrow; @Priya draft security one-pager and schedule a 30m review with their secops. I'll coordinate the calendar invite.
Marco: quick verification command to confirm S3 endpoint reachability in their VPC: `curl -sS "https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-logs/test.txt" --resolve s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com:443:<VPC_ENDPOINT_IP>` — if returns 200 then endpoint wiring is good.
Luis: posted PR 23 with role policy change (link: https://github.com/redwood/priv-deploy/pull/23). note: uses least-priv design, will add the customer's admin ARNs once they confirm.
telemetry-bot: info: after route add and role tweak, put success rate climbed to 98% in staging.
Anika: customer sentiment: "appreciate quick hands-on but want clearer handoff and a fallback plan for log loss" — that's a medium renewal risk note. let's capture in renewal tracker.
Priya: capturing feedback for product: consolidate runbook generator + one-click endpoint template. filing a jira: RW-ENG-1427.
Anika: next check-in: tomorrow 13:00PT after staging run. I'll post an update here. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Luis: on it.
Marco: will validate post-apply and share logs.
telemetry-bot: scheduled report posted to #cs-weekly tomorrow 09:00PT.
